look_here_first: Accepted distinct Triodanis species reported native eastern Texas. Begin with five-lobed purple corolla, alternate leaves and an inferior many-seeded capsule, but accurate species-level separation NEEDS voucher-based leaf, flower and mature capsule macros. Do not use coloradoensis/another species as a photo substitute.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Small annual herb of the bellflower family; plant form and flowering-stem architecture help preliminary identification.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Simple alternate leaves; specialist comparison needed for exact blade dimensions and attachment.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Individual five-lobed usually blue-violet fused corolla at a stem leaf axil; upper open and lower closed flowers may coexist.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Inferior capsule with side opening; precise window position unconfirmed in this card.

key_traits.label: Stem
key_traits.text: Alternate leafy annual stem with calyx and flower parts above an inferior ovary.

source_credit: Existing Hays Botany species record and scientific source notes; original full record retained in assigned family staging branch
